extensionDescription.message: Sync your tab groups across computers through your own server, and restore them from history when something gets closed by mistake.

syncIntro.message: Pick one destination. Firefox Sync works with no setup but has a small size limit and no history. The other options need a server you control and unlock history and larger sessions.

backendBrowserSyncHint.message: Uses your Mozilla account. No setup, but limited to about 100 KB and no history.

backendWebdavHint.message: Nextcloud, ownCloud, Synology, or any WebDAV server.

backendRestHint.message: A small JSON API you host yourself.

backendGitHint.message: GitHub, Gitea, or Forgejo. Keeps its own file history too.

testFailAuth.message: The server rejected the credentials. Connect again to get a new app password.

testFailNotFound.message: The folder was not found. Pick another one or create it.

testFailNetwork.message: Could not reach the server. Check the address and that it is available from this computer.

testFailPermission.message: Firefox has not been given access to this server yet. Allow it and try again.

testFailGeneric.message: The server answered with an error: $DETAIL$

securityIntro.message: Your tab titles and addresses are encrypted on this computer before they are uploaded. Nobody with access to the server can read them without this password.

masterPasswordWrong.message: That password does not match the one your other computers used.

masterPasswordNoRecovery.message: There is no way to recover this password. If you lose it, the data on the server cannot be read again.

syncCredentials.message: Also sync the server credentials, encrypted

syncCredentialsHint.message: Saves one setup step on a new computer. The credentials are only readable with your master password.

contentIntro.message: Tabs that are not in a group stay on this computer. Move a tab into a group to share it.

filterModeExclude.message: All groups except the ones I list

filterApplyIncoming.message: Apply this list to incoming groups too

filterApplyIncomingHint.message: Groups from other computers that match will not be opened here.

filterMatchingNone.message: Right now this matches no group on this computer.

historyIntro.message: A snapshot is saved when your groups change, so you can bring back a group or a tab you closed by mistake.

historyUnavailable.message: History needs one of the server options. Firefox Sync is too small to hold it.

historyPerDevice.message: Each computer keeps its own history.

exportSettingsHint.message: A file with your server settings, for a computer that does not use Firefox Sync.

resetConfirm.message: This clears the settings on this computer. Your groups on the server are left alone.

popupNoBackend.message: Choose where to store your groups to get started.

encStateLocked.message: This computer needs the master password before it can sync.

encStateLockedNew.message: Your groups on the server are encrypted. Enter the master password you set on your other computer.

encChangeWarning.message: Every group on the server is rewritten under the new password. Your other computers will ask for it the next time they sync.

encDisableWarning.message: Everything on the server is rewritten unencrypted.

encCredentialsRestored.message: Server credentials picked up from your other computer.

popupUnlockPrompt.message: Enter your master password to sync.

testFailUnreachable.message: Firefox could not reach the server. The usual causes are an untrusted certificate, a wrong address, or the server not being reachable from this computer.

openServerInTab.message: Open the server in a tab

openServerInTabHint.message: If the certificate is self-signed, open the server once in a normal tab and accept the warning. Firefox cannot show that warning during a background request.

permMissing.message: Firefox does not have access to $ORIGIN$ yet. Press Connect to grant it.

permInvalidUrl.message: That does not look like a full address. Include https:// and no path.

testOkCreated.message: Connection works. The folder did not exist, so it was created.

historyEmpty.message: No snapshots yet. One is saved the first time a sync uploads a change.

syncFailConflict.message: Another computer was writing at the same time. The next sync will pick it up.

testOkNoEtag.message: Connection works, but the server does not return version tags. Editing the same group on two computers at once may lose one of the changes.

testOkNoIfMatch.message: Connection works, but the server ignores conditional writes. Editing the same group on two computers at once may lose one of the changes.

setupDeviceHint.message: You will see this name when browsing history from your other computers.

syncFailSchema.message: The data on the server was written by a newer version of this extension. Update it, or clear the folder to start over.

runDiagnostics.message: Test how the server handles writes

runDiagnosticsHint.message: Writes a scratch file, tries every kind of conditional write, then deletes it. Copy the result if something is not working.

testOkBrokenEtag.message: Connection works, but something between Firefox and Nextcloud is rewriting version tags — often a reverse proxy that compresses responses. Syncing works; simultaneous edits on two computers may lose one change. Disabling compression or ETag rewriting for this path fixes it.

lastFailureTrace.message: Requests from the last failed sync

setupDestPrompt.message: Pick a destination below and connect it. Then continue.

setupEncPrompt.message: Decide now whether your tab titles and addresses are encrypted before they leave this computer.

samePasswordEverywhere.message: Use the same master password on every computer. It is what lets them read each other's groups.

encStateChangedElsewhere.message: The master password was changed on another computer. Syncing is paused until you enter the new one here.

syncPausedLocked.message: Syncing is paused until you enter the master password.

encExistingServer.message: Your groups on the server are already encrypted. Enter the master password you chose on your other computer.

webdavModeNextcloudHint.message: Sign in through your server. No password is stored.

webdavModeGenericHint.message: Synology, kDrive, Fastmail, Apache mod_dav. Needs the full WebDAV address and a login.

davUrlHint.message: The full address of your WebDAV collection, for example https://example.com/dav or https://example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me

testFailAuthToken.message: The server rejected the token. Check that it matches the one configured on the server, and that the server passes the Authorization header through to the script.

testFailNoCredentials.message: No token has been entered for this destination yet.

diagnoseUnavailable.message: This destination has no write test.

deleteDeviceHint.message: Its snapshots are deleted and it disappears from the list. Groups it shared stay: they belong to everyone.

popupOpenHereTitle.message: Adds its groups to the ones already open here. Yours are untouched.

popupReplaceHereTitle.message: Closes the groups open here and opens that computer's instead. A snapshot is saved first, so it is recoverable from history.

popupIgnoreTitle.message: Dismisses the notice. You will be asked again only when that computer changes something new.

deviceNameHint.message: This becomes the name of its file on the server. Letters, digits, - and _ only; spaces become underscores.

deviceNameMine.message: This is already this computer's file. It will carry on where it left off.

deviceNameTaken.message: Another computer is already using this name, last written $WHEN$. Using it anyway means taking over that file, which is what you want after a reinstall.

deviceNameInvalid.message: Choose a name using letters, digits, - or _.

deviceRenameHint.message: The file on the server is renamed too, with its snapshots. Nothing is lost.

devicesUnreadable.message: Sealed with a different master password and cannot be opened here: $LIST$

quotaExceeded.message: Firefox Sync is full. It allows about 100 KB per extension, which a large session can exceed. Use a server destination for more room, or sync fewer groups.
